verdict.rationale: CrewAI is primarily a Python framework driven via code/CLI rather than a documented public REST API, but CrewAI Enterprise/AMP does expose documented REST endpoints (POST /kickoff, GET /status, POST /resume) for driving crew execution, plus webhook streaming. However, the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s on all standard paths, indicating no discoverable machine-readable API schema, and full API access appears gated behind the enterprise/AMP tier rather than the open-source core. missing for 10: publicly discoverable OpenAPI/schema spec, evidence the API is available outside the paid AMP/Enterprise tier, independent hands-on confirmation of API usage.
